title: One-off checkouts with a 100% promo code are booked
Stripe checkout can accept promotion codes
customer.subscription.created without a linked checkout session is redelivered while young
Stripe checkouts are matched by session id, consentId metadata is gone
detail: `createCheckoutSession` returns the Checkout Session id as `providerCheckoutId`, and `customer.subscription.created` looks up the session of the subscription (`checkout.sessions.list`) to carry that id; if the Stripe API call fails, the webhook replies 503 so Stripe retries; a successful empty list yields a created event without checkout id that is ignored as not in the ledger. Session metadata carries only the tenantId. The new option `clientConfig` passes Stripe SDK client settings, for tests against a local fixture API.
migration: Open Checkout Sessions from before the upgrade are not in the ledger and their `customer.subscription.created` and payment events are ignored; let them expire or finish first. The API key of the Stripe plugin needs read access to Checkout Sessions.

title: Stripe plugin has a displayName
A malformed stored credential no longer leaks into the error
stripeEnvSchema adds price slots to the Stripe env block
A stale Stripe customer id no longer turns the customer portal into a 500
Stripe checkout sets submit_type, locale, submit text and consentId; cancel can run to period end
Stripe webhooks no longer archive the full provider event
plan switch rejects unretrievable prices, concurrent request-deletion loser reports the fresh user status
Checkout retries without a customer id Stripe no longer knows
One-off payment checkouts create a customer when none is passed
Stripe unknown price intervals stay consistent, plan-switch errors keep their cause, dropped paid sessions are logged
Stripe retrieve transient errors answer 503 instead of ignored
subscription-stripe narrows a recurring price interval to a closed union instead of widening on an unrecognized Stripe value
subscription-stripe bumps the stripe SDK to ^22.6.2 and fixes the resulting price-interval type break
switch-plan returns a 422 instead of a 500 when two plan tiers share one Stripe product
Stripe subscription status incomplete_expired now maps to canceled instead of incomplete
subscription-stripe implements retrievePrices, createPlanSwitchSession and isBillingEnabled for the shared billing-plans catalog
subscription-stripe mode:"payment" checkouts now get a Stripe invoice by default
detail:
createCheckoutSession's mode:"payment" call (one-off top-ups etc.) never
passed invoice_creation, so Stripe never generated an invoice document for
those payments. It now defaults to `invoice_creation: { enabled: true }`
for mode:"payment" — mode:"subscription" is unaffected, Stripe rejects
invoice_creation there. Stripe Invoicing charges a per-invoice fee on top
of the payment itself, so an existing high-volume, low-value payment flow
may see new fees appear.
migration:
Pass `createSubscriptionStripeFeature({ paymentInvoiceCreation: false })`
to opt out and keep the old no-invoice behaviour for mode:"payment" checkouts.
